description: BlueSky: publish a post. Supports plain text with auto-facets (@mentions, links, #hashtags), replies (replyTo), quote-posts (quote), and up to 4 images (by url or local path, each with alt text). A link card (OG preview with thumbnail) is auto-generated for the first URL when the post has no images and no quote. Returns the new post uri+cid. In a scheduled automation SynaBun spaces Bluesky writes (posts, replies, likes, reposts, follows and their undos, DMs) a minute or two apart inside this call: never sleep, start a background shell or a Monitor, or end your turn to wait between writes. When the gap needs longer than one call, the call writes nothing, says so, and the next identical call waits the rest.

images.description: Up to 4 images; give url OR path for each. Images take precedence over a quote embed.

path.description: Local file path on this machine (uploaded via the Neural Interface).

url.description: Image URL the browser can fetch.

quote.description: Quote-post this post (AT-URI or bsky.app URL).

replyTo.description: Reply to this post (AT-URI or bsky.app URL). Root/parent refs are derived automatically.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session (the bsky.app tab). Auto-resolved if omitted.

text.description: Post text (max 300 graphemes). @mentions, URLs and #hashtags are auto-detected into rich-text facets.

name: bluesky_post
